cohort: The study cohort consisted of 11,792 women in labour at a single institution between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2021.
finding: The use of round-the-clock labour epidural analgesia was associated with a decreased incidence of caesarean section.
mod_finding: The use of labour epidural analgesia was associated with a decreased incidence of unintended caesarean section compared to the non-labour epidural analgesia group.
